scope: Opt-in structured Model 3 estimator; same rule for reference and candidate specifications.
trigger: Complete 1000-draw fit with all non-ratio native checks passed and at least one failed convergence ratio.
short_pass: Accept an already valid short fit; this is a prespecified supplemental gate, not uniform 3000-draw certification.
continuation_after_diagnostic_failure: Use the original optimization checkpoint, not the diagnostic result, as prevAns.
complete_3000_failure: Continue or exhaust the existing schedule; never reassess the unchanged vector.
native_invalid: No precision reassessment; preserve ordinary continuation/failure behavior.
incomplete_operation: Stop and retain evidence; no automatic rerun on resume.
historical_imports: Not automatic. A separately audited checkpoint-import procedure is required; historical acceptance and forecasts are not migrated.
evidence_basis: Steps 3B/3C at 7972dc9cac17ef62f78c774b1b8186d18ce9d1e1; descriptive evidence for two vectors, not universal certification.
